papers.title: Auditable CT Phenotyping Through Report-derived Radiological Observations
papers.authors: Riga Wu, Walter Witschey, Yicheng Li, Felix Barajas Ordonez, Keno K. Bressem, Lisa C. Adams, Gary E. Weissman, Li Shen, Christos Davatzikos, Eduardo Barbosa, Daniel Truhn, Tianyu Han
papers.tags: medical image, multimodal learning, image classification
papers.affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, University Hospital RWTH Aachen, Technical University of Munich, University Hospital Essen
papers.intro: 本文提出可审计CT表型分析（ACT）框架，利用报告派生的放射学观察作为图像标注、表型预测、模型审计和限制的共同语言，揭示了准确CT表型预测可能建立在无效观察上，并能识别和干预这些捷径。

papers.title: TAU-Agent: An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Traffic Anomaly Understanding
papers.authors: Yuqiang Lin, Yan Shi, Sam Lockyer, Harish Tayyar Madabushi, Adrian Evans, Wenbin Li, Yinhai Wang, Nic Zhang
papers.tags: video search, object detection, tracking, YOLO
papers.affiliations: University of Bath, University of Washington
papers.intro: TAU-Agent提出了一种基于智能体检索增强的框架，通过主检索智能体协调视频字幕工具和开放词汇跟踪工具来检索查询相关的证据，并由监督微调的视频语言模型进行最终推理和答案生成，以解决交通异常理解任务。

papers.title: When Composition Doesn't Add Up: Humans Identifying Defects in AI-Generated Images
papers.authors: Ruoqi Hu, Chulin Zhao, Jiashuo Chang, Ramon Ruiz-Dolz, Hanhe Lin
papers.tags: image generation
papers.affiliations: Dundee International Institute of Central South University, Central South University, China; Faculty of Science, Engineering and Business, University of Dundee, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 本文通过设计并实施一项大规模主观实验，构建了首个组合性AI生成图像缺陷数据集CO-AID，系统揭示了人类识别AI生成图像中组合性缺陷的机制，并验证了该数据集在缺陷预测和图像生成优化方面的实用性。

papers.title: Do Vision-Language Models Agree on the Affective Qualities of Shape? A Cross-Model Audit for Generative Design Interfaces
papers.authors: Luca Bux, Thiago Rios, Ingo Scholtes, Stefan Menzel
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image generation, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: Honda Research Institute Europe GmbH（Luca Bux, Thiago Rios, Stefan Menzel）；Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg（Ingo Scholtes）
papers.intro: 本文通过审计6种视觉语言模型在10个ShapeNetCore类别中对无纹理3D物体沿Kansei情感形容词对的排序一致性，提出了一种离线跨模型一致性审计方法，用于在生成式设计界面中决定哪些情感语义控制应被暴露给用户。

papers.title: LUTSeg: A Longitudinal Multi-Expert Dataset for Ulcer Tissue Segmentation
papers.authors: Karen Sanchez, Carlos Hinojosa, Albert A. Ávila, Andrea C. Riano-Rojas, Diego H. Romero, Jenny C. Páez, Martina Llinás, Bernard Ghanem
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, medical image, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), Saudi Arabia; Subred Norte E.S.E, Hospital Simón Bolívar, Colombia; Universidad del Rosario, Bogotá, Colombia
papers.intro: 本文提出了LUTSeg——一个包含141张麻风病相关溃疡图像、由5位临床专家标注5种组织类别的纵向多专家数据集，并提出了TiSage半监督组织分割框架，通过融合冻结医学视觉语言模型的多尺度语义先验与教师-学生架构，在低标注率场景下显著提升了组织分割性能。

papers.title: Learning Late, Guiding Early: Timestep-Decoupled Semantic Guidance for Fair Face Generation
papers.authors: Subir Kumar Parida, Rajbabu Velmurugan, Ketan Kotwal, R. S. Sengar, Swati Hiremath
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (B.A.R.C.), Mumbai, India; Department of Electrical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Mumbai, India
papers.intro: 本文提出 Semantic Boundary Predictor (SBP)，一种推理时的一次性引导框架，通过在不同扩散时间步解耦语义边界学习与语义引导，在不重新训练或微调潜在扩散模型的情况下实现公平的人脸生成。

papers.title: Precipitation Downscaling Using Foundation Model-Conditioned Diffusion
papers.authors: Victor Nascimento Ribeiro, Jorge Guevara, Jorge Sebastian Moraga, Chris Lucas, Natalie Lord, Andrew Taylor, Edward Lockhart, Will Trojak, Johannes Schmude, Anne Jones
papers.tags: diffusion model, image generation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: IBM Research, Fathom, STFC Hartree Centre
papers.intro: 本文系统比较了三种条件化策略（通道拼接、可学习卷积编码器的交叉注意力、预训练天气基础模型Prithvi WxC的交叉注意力）对扩散模型降水降尺度性能的影响，发现交叉注意力条件化在分布真实性和极端事件捕捉方面优于简单拼接，且预训练基础模型在数据有限场景下具有显著优势。

papers.title: DEFUSE: Generalizable Backdoor Defense for Self-Supervised Encoders with Generative Priors
papers.authors: Tuo Chen, Jie Gui, Minjing Dong, Lanting Fang, Ju Jia, Benlei Cui, Jian Liu
papers.tags: diffusion model, image generation
papers.affiliations: Southeast University, Ant Group, Purple Mountain Laboratories, City University of Hong Kong, Beijing Institute of Technology, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: DEFUSE提出了一种基于生成先验的通用后门检测框架，通过条件扩散模型将可疑编码器的表示重建为图像，并在语义空间中评估重建一致性，从而无需攻击策略先验知识即可检测视觉SSL和视觉-语言编码器中的后门。

papers.title: Socialized Detector Learning: Trajectory-Guided and Reciprocal Distillation for Heterogeneous Object Detectors
papers.authors: Weihao Li, Yunqi Zhu, Zhihe Fan, Ruipu Zhao, Boan Tao, Xinjie Yao, Yan Fan, Pengfei Zhu
papers.tags: object detection, image classification, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: 天津大学、天津体育学院、昆明理工大学、国防科技大学、东南大学、新南威尔士大学（详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出Socialized Detector Learning（SDL）框架及Trajectory-Guided and Reciprocal Distillation（TGRD）方法，通过估计检测器间的定向传递难度来规划知识传递轨迹，沿轨迹将互补知识渐进整合到统一类别载体中，再通过互惠蒸馏将知识…

papers.title: Label-Free Foundational Model Selection for Medical Image Classification under Distribution Shift via Pseudo Label Discrepancy
papers.authors: Juan Iñaki Larrea, Lucas Mansilla, Enzo Ferrante
papers.tags: CLIP, image classification
papers.affiliations: Applied Artificial Intelligence Lab (LIAA), Computer Sciences Institute (ICC), Universidad de Buenos Aires - CONICET, Argentina; Research Institute for Signals, Systems and Computational Intelligence, sinc(i), Universidad Nacional del Litoral - CONICET, Argentina
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于伪标签差异的无标签模型选择准则（AURCC），利用SUDO框架在无目标域标注的情况下对多个医学影像基础模型进行排序，在胸部X光肺炎分类任务中有效恢复真实性能排序，尤其在源域标注数据稀缺时优于传统基线方法。

papers.title: Bootstrapping a 4D LiDAR Annotation Tool from Video Foundation Models
papers.authors: Jihun Kim, Hyun-Kurl Jang, Hyemin Yang, Jinnyeong Yang, Hyeokjun Kweon, Kuk-Jin Yoon
papers.tags: panoptic segmentation, video segmentation, autonomous driving, BEV perception, LiDAR
papers.affiliations: KAIST（韩国科学技术院）、Chung-Ang University（中央大学）
papers.intro: 本文提出LiDAR-SAM2框架，将2D视频基础模型SAM2转化为4D LiDAR领域的可扩展监督来源，通过自动生成伪标签训练交互式4D LiDAR分割模型，无需任何人工LiDAR标注即可达到接近全人工标注的性能。

papers.title: LAION-BVD: A 10-Million-Hour Open Video Dataset for Multimodal Pre-training
papers.authors: Andreas Hochlehnert, Marianna Nezhurina, Mehdi Cherti, Andrej Radonjic, Thaddäus Wiedemer, Christoph Schuhmann, Romain Beaumont, Wieland Brendel, Bernhard Schölkopf, A. Sophia Koepke, Jenia Jitsev, Matthias Bethge
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video generation, image generation
papers.affiliations: University of Tübingen, Tübingen AI Center; LAION; JSC, FZJ; Wynd Labs; MPI for Intelligent Systems, ELLIS Institute Tübingen; Technical University of Munich, MCML
papers.intro: 本文提出了LAION-BVD，一个包含8000万视频、总时长1000万小时的超大规模开放多模态视频数据集，并配套了可扩展的多模态标注流水线，验证了其在视频-文本、音频-文本和图像-文本预训练中的有效性。

papers.title: MoE-based Feature Adapter for Prompt-free Binary Coronary Artery Segmentation in X-ray Angiography
papers.authors: Lin Xi, Yingliang Ma
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, medical image, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: University College London, United Kingdom; University of East Anglia, United Kingdom; King's College London, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于混合专家（MoE）的无提示特征适配器框架，通过多个轻量级专家分支和输入依赖的top-k路由机制，实现对X射线冠状动脉造影中异质血管外观的自适应特征细化，从而提升二值冠状动脉分割性能和跨数据集泛化能力。

papers.title: Interpretable Fundus Image Classification via Ring-Based Retinal Vasculature Features
papers.authors: Xiaoyan Li, Shixin Xu, Arvind Gupta, Huaxiong Huang
papers.tags: medical image, image classification, semantic segmentation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: University of Toronto, York University, Duke Kunshan University, Fields Institute for Research in Mathematical Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于视盘中心同心环形区域的视网膜血管特征表示方法，通过量化血管几何、颜色、氧合相关外观和血管-背景熵等生理学驱动的描述符，实现了无需大规模任务特定训练数据的可解释眼底图像分类，在HRF数据集上达到了与预训练视觉Transformer RETFound相当的准确率。

papers.title: Game2World Engine: Unlocking In-the-Wild Gameplay Videos for World Model Training
papers.authors: Wenxuan Shen, Dongna Jin, Dongping Chen
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: 未明确（通讯作者 Dongping Chen 邮箱为 dongpingchen0612@gmail.com）
papers.intro: 本文提出了Game2World引擎，通过形式化的游戏UI分类体系（GameUI-Taxonomy）、自动UI资产提取与合成管线（G2WEngine）、大规模数据集（Game2World）以及无掩码UI移除模型（GameCleaner），将互联网游戏视频转化为高质量的世界模型训练数据。

papers.title: ReGround-Surg: Reliability-Guided Anchor Grounding for Referring Surgical Video Segmentation
papers.authors: Jiaxin Wen, Ming Yin, Lu Liu, Zeyu Fu
papers.tags: video segmentation, visual grounding, Segment Anything, semantic segmentation
papers.affiliations: University of Exeter, Exeter, UK
papers.intro: 本文提出ReGround-Surg，一种轻量级可靠性引导的锚定接地框架，通过预测文本条件空间可靠性图并复用于门控侧适配器和可靠性加权V2T注意力模块，显著提升SAM2-based Referring Surgical Video Segmentation的初始锚定质量，从而改善整体分割性能。

papers.title: X-MULTI: VLM-based Imaging Factor Disentanglement for Factor-Aware Image Synthesis
papers.authors: Sonali Godavarthy, Matthias Neuwirth-Trapp, Tim-Felix Faasch, Maarten Bieshaar, Michael Moeller, Kristof Van Laerhoven, Danda Pani Paudel
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: University of Siegen, ETH Zürich, Bosch Research, INSAIT, Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski"
papers.intro: 本文提出X-MULTI方法，利用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）对训练中合成的新颖因子组合进行零样本监督，并提出改进的I-FAA评估指标，通过因子特定增强和类平衡采样减少跨因子相关性泄漏，从而提升成像因子解耦的质量和评估的可靠性。

papers.title: Hierarchical Prototype-Memory Adaptation of SAM for Surgical Instrument Segmentation
papers.authors: Xinning Yao, Jingjing Wang, Jinghua Yue, Xiaoyan Luo, Fugen Zhou, Bo Liu
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, Segment Anything, medical image, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Image Processing Center, Beihang University, Beijing, 100191, China
papers.intro: 本文提出HPMA框架，通过构建冻结的多尺度原型记忆库并设计层级表示级别到模块的耦合机制，将SAM适配到手术器械分割任务，在EndoVis2017和EndoVis2018数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

papers.title: It depends: Incorporating correlations for joint aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties of high-dimensional output spaces
papers.authors: Leonhard F. Feiner, Manuel Nickel, Martin Menten, Laurin Lux, Rickmer Braren, Daniel Rueckert, Georgios Kaissis, Raphael Rehms, Johannes Paetzold
papers.tags: depth estimation, image generation
papers.affiliations: Technical University of Munich, University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf, Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML), Weill Cornell Medicine, German Cancer Consortium (DKTK), Imperial College London, Hasso Plattner Institute for Digital Engineering, Cornell University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于低秩加对角（LR+D）协方差参数化的方法，将aleatoric和epistemic不确定性高效地联合建模为统一的二阶分布，在高维输出空间中捕获输出相关性，并在图像修复、着色、光流和深度估计任务上取得优于现有方法的不确定性量化性能。

papers.title: DoublesEval: Diagnosing Multi-Agent Tactical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Professional Doubles Badminton
papers.authors: Jintao Cheng, Weibin Li
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, tracking, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; University of Macau
papers.intro: 本文提出了DoublesEval，一个基于职业双打羽毛球视频的诊断性评估框架，通过四个可解释的推理维度系统性地诊断视觉语言模型在多智能体战术推理中的能力缺陷，并提出了TacticCheck这一轻量级测试时一致性检查器来缓解这些缺陷。
